summary: Bluerock Homes Trust filed an 8-K reporting the completed disposition, from January 1 through October 14, 2026, of its interest in 31 single-family residential units in the ILE joint-venture portfolio (Texas and Southeast), in which it holds 95%. Aggregate sales price was approximately $6.6 million across multiple separate purchase and sale agreements with unaffiliated third parties, subject to customary closing costs, prorations and adjustments; after mortgage paydowns, net proceeds were approximately $2.0 million. Pro forma balance sheet and income statements were furnished. No board recommendation or advisor named. Asset-level sales, not an enterprise deal; watch pace of remaining unit sales and any realized gains versus carrying value.
